title: Explorer section tabs
responsibility: Renders a selectable horizontal strip of explorer sections.

inputs.name: HarnessTabs.onview
inputs.description: Required callback receiving the chosen section after a plain link click or enabled button click.

inputs.name: HarnessTabs.tabs
inputs.description: Optional tab definitions, defaulting to JavaScript undefined (omitted). Omission uses map, compare, history, growth and activity; an explicitly empty list renders no tabs. Definitions may provide destinations and disabled state. Tab identifiers must be distinct.

inputs.name: HarnessTabs.label
inputs.description: Optional accessible navigation label, defaulting to Views.

outputs.name: HarnessTabs
outputs.description: Links for enabled tabs with destinations and buttons otherwise. Keeps the selected tab visible within the scrolling strip without moving focus or scrolling the page. Overflow retains a painted horizontal scrollbar and persistent text explaining horizontal scrolling. The cue updates when the strip or tab widths change.

errors.name: Duplicate tab key
errors.description: Duplicate tab identifiers are rejected by Svelte keyed-list updates.

errors.name: Caller callback error
errors.description: Errors thrown by the supplied onview callback propagate from an enabled button or plain link click.
